description: This script checks whether a specific feature (LSA) is enabled based on configuration files and environment variables. It sources configuration files, defines functions for logging and feature checking, and outputs a status code indicating if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: ifeLogging
methods.description: Logs messages with a timestamp to the rfcscript.log file.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given feature is enabled by inspecting RFC variables and configuration files.
